title: The DBMS must prohibit the use of cached authenticators after an organization-defined time period.
check_content:
Review system settings to determine whether the organization-defined limit for cached authentication is implemented.

If it is not implemented, this is a finding.
fixtext: Modify system settings to implement the organization-defined limit on the lifetime of cached authenticators.
VulnDiscussion: If cached authentication information is out-of-date, the validity of the authentication information may be questionable.
